onboarding.welcomeTagline: The fun layer on top of Return Right. Recycle, build streaks, dress up your buddy.
onboarding.slide1Body: ReLoop sits on top of Singapore’s Return Right deposit scheme. Every container you return earns rewards — but only when it’s really returned.
onboarding.slide2Body: Return at least one container each week to keep your streak alive. Miss a week and it resets — so make it a habit, not a chore.
onboarding.slide3Body: Not sure if something is recyclable? Check before you bin it. Putting the wrong thing in spoils the whole batch.

about.title: About ReLoop
about.missionBody: ReLoop makes returning your bottles and cans a habit worth keeping. We add streaks, points and bite-sized recycling education on top of Singapore’s official deposit scheme — we don’t handle your deposit or refund ourselves.
about.howBody: Return a container at a Return Right point, scan the confirmation, and we verify it before awarding points. Every point comes from a real, verified return.
about.disclaimer: ReLoop is an engagement layer on top of Singapore’s BCRS “Return Right” deposit scheme. It does not replace it.
